title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 12 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 12 - Appellate Tribunal “Appellate Tribunal’’ means the Taxes Appellate Tribunal established under section 13; Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
